### 1. `TranslationProvider.tsx`
```tsx
"use client";
import React, { createContext, useContext, useState, useEffect } from "react";

type Messages = Record<string, string>;

const TranslationContext = createContext<Messages>({});

export function TranslationProvider({
  locale,
  children,
}: {
  locale: string;
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const [messages, setMessages] = useState<Messages>({});

  useEffect(() => {
    const loadMessages = async () => {
      try {
        const result = (
          await import(`../../messages/${locale}.json`)
        ).default;
        setMessages(result);
      } catch (error) {
        setMessages({ hello: "Not found", welcome: "Locale not supported" });
      }
    };
    loadMessages();
  }, [locale]);

  return (
    <TranslationContext.Provider value={messages}>
      {children}
    </TranslationContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTranslations() {
  const messages = useContext(TranslationContext);
  return (key: string, vars?: Record<string, string>) => {
    let text = messages[key] ?? key;
    if (vars) {
      for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(vars)) {
        text = text.replace(`{${k}}`, v);
      }
    }
    return text;
  };
}
```

---

  return (

      <h1>{t("hello")}</h1>
      <p>{t("welcome", { name: "Fayzillo" })}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

export default function LocalePage({ params }: { params: { locale: string } }) {
  return (
    <TranslationProvider locale={params.locale}>
      <PageContent />
    </TranslationProvider>
  );
}
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, Next.js’da **faqat bitta `middleware` function** bo‘ladi. 🚦

```ts
// middleware.ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  try {
    // Auth middleware
    if (!request.cookies.get("token")) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login", request.url));
    }

    // Agar hammasi ok bo‘lsa → davom etsin
    return NextResponse.next();
  } catch (err) {
    // Error middleware o‘rnida
    console.error("Middleware error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Something went wrong" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

👉 Ya’ni Express’dagi kabi **bir nechta middleware chain emas**, balki bitta function ichida **shart va try/catch bilan** boshqarasiz.

```ts
// middleware.ts
import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { checkAuth } from "./lib/auth";
import { detectLocale } from "./lib/locale";

export function middleware(req: NextRequest) {
  try {
    if (!checkAuth(req)) {
      return NextResponse.redirect(new URL("/login", req.url));
    }

    const locale = detectLocale(req);
    console.log("User locale:", locale);

    return NextResponse.next();
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Middleware error:", err);
    return NextResponse.json({ error: "Server error" }, { status: 500 });
  }
}
```

👉 Bu usulda `middleware.ts` faqat **entry point**, asosiy checking va helper funksiyalar esa `lib/` yoki `utils/` ichida bo‘ladi.

- Kod **toza va o‘qilishi oson** bo‘ladi

 ├─ lib/                # biznes logika & helperlar
 │   ├─ auth.ts         # auth check funksiyalari
 │   ├─ locale.ts       # locale aniqlash funksiyalari
 │   ├─ db.ts           # database client (prisma, drizzle…)
 │   └─ utils.ts        # umumiy kichik helperlar
 │
 ├─ components/         # UI componentlar (button, header, form…)
 │   ├─ ui/             # shared UI (design system)
 │   └─ layout/         # layout / navbar / footer
 │
 ├─ hooks/              # custom React hooklar
 │   └─ useAuth.ts
 │
 ├─ styles/             # global css yoki tailwind config
 │
 └─ messages/           # i18n json fayllar (en.json, uz.json…)
```

### Asosiy best practice qoidalari:
1. **`app/` faqat routing va UI uchun** — biznes logikani yozmaysiz.  
2. **Biznes logika `lib/` yoki `services/` ichida** — middleware, API, component hammasi shu helperlardan foydalanadi.  
3. **Reusable UI `components/` ichida** — kichik va qayta ishlatiladigan qismlar.  
4. **Middleware toza bo‘lishi kerak** — faqat helperlarni chaqirsin, ichida katta logika bo‘lmasin.  
5. **API routes** (`app/api/...`) — faqat request/response mapping qiladi, asosiy ishni `lib/` yoki `services/` bajaradi.  

Shu bilan loyihani katta qilganingizda ham tartib buzilmaydi.

👉 Masalan:  

```
src/
 ├─ app/

```

**`services/userService.ts`**
```ts
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export async function getUsers() {
  return db.user.findMany();
}

export async function createUser(data: { name: string; email: string }) {
  return db.user.create({ data });
}
```

**`app/api/users/route.ts`**
```ts
import { NextResponse } from "next/server";
import { getUsers, createUser } from "@/services/userService";

export async function GET() {
  const users = await getUsers();
  return NextResponse.json(users);
}

export async function POST(req: Request) {
  const body = await req.json();
  const user = await createUser(body);
  return NextResponse.json(user, { status: 201 });
}
```

🔑 Shunda:  
- **route.ts** → faqat "controller" vazifasida  
- **service.ts** → asosiy biznes logika  
- **lib/db.ts** → database ulanishi  

Bu arxitektura backenddagidek: **controller → service → db**.

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

NextJs da decorator bormi va custom yzish mumkinmi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, Next.js’da **decorator** degan native konsept yo‘q, lekin siz uni **JavaScript / TypeScript funksiyalari orqali “higher-order” yoki wrapper** sifatida yozishingiz mumkin.  

Qisqacha:  

---

### 1. Native decorator support
- TypeScript’da **experimentalDecorators** yoqilgan bo‘lsa, `@decorator` sintaksisi ishlaydi:  

```ts
// tsconfig.json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "experimentalDecorators": true
  }
}
```

- Misol:  

```ts
function log(target: any, key: string, descriptor: PropertyDescriptor) {
  const original = descriptor.value;
  descriptor.value = function(...args: any[]) {
    console.log(`Calling ${key} with`, args);
    return original.apply(this, args);
  };
}

class Test {
  @log
  hello(name: string) {
    console.log(`Hello ${name}`);
  }
}

new Test().hello("Fayzillo");
```

---

### 2. Next.js va React-da “custom decorators”
- React componentlar uchun **Higher-Order Component (HOC)** ishlatiladi:  

```tsx
function withAuth(Component) {
  return function Wrapped(props) {
    // auth tekshiruv
    const user = { loggedIn: true };
    if (!user.loggedIn) return <p>Access denied</p>;
    return <Component {...props} />;
  };
}

// ishlatish
const ProtectedPage = withAuth(PageComponent);
```

- Bu HOC aslida **decorator’ga o‘xshaydi**: componentni o‘rab, qo‘shimcha logika qo‘shadi.  

---

💡 Qisqacha:  
- **Native decorator** → TypeScript + experimentalDecorators  
- **React/Next.js** → HOC orqali custom decorator yaratish mumkin

"use client";
import React from "react";

// HOC decorator
function withParams(Component) {
  return function Wrapped(props) {
    // props.params ni oladi
    const { params } = props;
    return <Component {...props} params={params} />;
  };
}

// Page component

  console.log("Params:", params); // params bilan ishlash
  return <div>Locale: {params.locale}</div>;
}

// HOC bilan export
export default withParams(MyPage);
```

- Middleware / route handler dan kelgan params’ni **automatic inject qilasiz**

"use client";
import React from "react";

export function withParams<P extends { params?: any }>(
  Component: React.ComponentType<P>
) {
  return function Wrapped(props: P) {
    // Next.js page component props ichida `params` keladi

  };
}
```

```tsx

interface PageProps {
  params: {
    locale: string;
  };
}

}

// HOC orqali export

Next-Intl config odatda **`app/` yoki `src` ichida alohida fayl** sifatida yoziladi va keyin global provider’da ishlatiladi.  

### Misol struktura

```
app/
 └─ layout.tsx

          └─ ru.json
```

---

### `src/intl/config.ts` misol

```ts
export const locales = ["en", "uz", "ru"];
export const defaultLocale = "en";
export const messages = {
  en: () => import("./messages/en.json").then((m) => m.default),
  uz: () => import("./messages/uz.json").then((m) => m.default),
  ru: () => import("./messages/ru.json").then((m) => m.default),
};
```

---

### `app/layout.tsx` da ishlatish

```tsx
import { NextIntlProvider } from 'next-intl';
import { messages, defaultLocale } from '@/intl/config';

export default async function RootLayout({ children, params }) {
  const locale = params.locale || defaultLocale;
  const message = await messages[locale]();

  return (
    <html lang={locale}>
      <body>
        <NextIntlProvider messages={message}>
          {children}
        </NextIntlProvider>
      </body>
    </html>
  );
}
```

💡 **Qisqacha:**  

- **Config** → `src/intl/config.ts` kabi alohida fayl  
- **Messages** → har locale uchun JSON fayl  
- **Provider** → `layout.tsx` ichida global qilib o‘rnatiladi  

Agar xohlasa, men **middleware + config + page params + messages** ni bitta real example qilib chizib beray, shunda hamma layer birga ishlashini ko‘rasiz.

- Next.js static route **priority yuqori**

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, tushundim 👌 Siz `regions` massivini olasiz va ularga qarab `districts` massiviga **avtomatik ID** beradigan funksiya yozmoqchisiz.  

Keling, shunaqa `setId` funksiyani yozamiz:  

```ts
type Region = {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  label: string;
  districts: { value: string; label: string }[];
};

type District = {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  label: string;
  regionId: string;
};

function setId(regions: Region[]): District[] {
  const districts: District[] = [];

  regions.forEach((region, regionIndex) => {
    region.districts.forEach((d, districtIndex) => {
      districts.push({
        id: `${region.id}-${String(districtIndex + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
        value: d.value,
        label: d.label,
        regionId: region.id,
      });
    });
  });

  return districts;
}
```

---

### Ishlash mantig‘i:
- `region.id` → masalan `"A0001"`  
- `districtIndex + 1` → 1 dan boshlab tuman tartib raqami  
- `padStart(3, "0")` → `001`, `002`, `003` kabi format beradi  
- Natija: `A0001-001`, `A0001-002`, ...

        { value: "uchquduq", label: "Uchquduq tumani" },
    ],
};


function setId(regions: Region[]): Record<string, DistrictInID[]> {
    const result: Record<string, DistrictInID[]> = {};

    regions.forEach((region,index) => {
            result[region.value] = districts[region.value].map((el,i) => {
                return {
                    id : "A" + "".padStart("1000".length - `${i}`.length) + i,
                    regionId : region.id,
                    value : el.value,
                    label : el.label
                }
            })
    })
    return result;
}

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r boshlabsiz ✅  
Sizning `setId` funksiyangizda **id generatsiya qilish joyida kichkina xatolik** bor. `padStart` `string` qabul qiladi, lekin siz `number` bilan ishlatyapsiz (`i`).  

Uni quyidagicha to‘g‘rilash kerak 👇  

```ts
function setId(regions: Region[]): Record<string, DistrictInID[]> {
    const result: Record<string, DistrictInID[]> = {};

    regions.forEach((region) => {
        result[region.value] = districts[region.value].map((el, i) => {
            return {
                // index 0 bo‘lsa ham 0001 chiqadi
                id: `${region.id}-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
                regionId: region.id,
                value: el.value,
                label: el.label,
            };
        });
    });

    return result;
}
```

"use client"

import { districts, regions, setId } from "@/types/Country.type";
import { useState } from "react";

export default function Home() {
  const dist = setId(regions);

  const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedAddress, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);

  return (
    <div className="font-sans grid grid-rows-[20px_1fr_20px] items-center justify-items-center min-h-screen p-8 pb-20 gap-16 sm:p-20">
      <div className="container mx-auto">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold mb-4">Manzil tanlash</h1>

        {/* Region select */}
        <select
          className="border-2 rounded p-2"
          style={{ height: 40, width: 250 }}
          value={selectedRegion ?? ""}
          onChange={(e) => {
            setSelectedRegion(e.target.value);
            setSelectedAddress(null); // region o'zgarsa district reset bo'ladi
          }}
        >
          <option value="" disabled>
            Viloyatni tanlang
          </option>
          {regions.map((el) => (
            <option key={el.id} value={el.value}>
              {el.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        {/* District select */}
        {selectedRegion && (
          <div className="mt-4">
            <select
              className="border-2 rounded p-2"
              style={{ height: 40, width: 250 }}
              value={selectedAddress ?? ""}
              onChange={(e) => setSelectedAddress(e.target.value)}
            >
              <option value="" disabled>
                Tuman/Shaharni tanlang
              </option>
              {dist[selectedRegion].map((d) => (
                <option key={d.id} value={d.value}>
                  {d.label}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Tanlangan manzil */}
        {selectedRegion && selectedAddress && (
          <div className="mt-6 p-4 border rounded bg-gray-100">
            <p>
              <strong>Viloyat:</strong>{" "}
              {regions.find((r) => r.value === selectedRegion)?.label}
            </p>
            <p>
              <strong>Tuman/Shahar:</strong>{" "}
              {dist[selectedRegion].find((d) => d.value === selectedAddress)
                ?.label}
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

Ajoyib — mana to‘liq ishlaydigan **form komponenti** (Next.js client component, TypeScript/TSX).  
U quyidagilarni qiladi:

- Form maydonlari: `username`, `email`, `password`, `birthday` (date), `region`, `district`, `address` (street/uy).
- Oddiy validation (required, password length).
- Submit qilinganda konsolga to‘liq obyekti chiqadi (`regionId`, `regionLabel`, `districtId`, `districtLabel`, ...).

Faylni `app/page.tsx` yoki kerakli sahifaga joylang.

```tsx
"use client";

import { regions, districts as rawDistricts } from "@/types/Country.type";
import { useMemo, useState } from "react";

type DistrictInID = {
  id: string;
  value: string;
  label: string;
  regionId: string;
};

export default function HomeForm() {
  // helper: yaratadi districtsWithId: Record<regionValue, DistrictInID[]>
  const districts = useMemo<Record<string, DistrictInID[]>>(() => {
    const res: Record<string, DistrictInID[]> = {};
    regions.forEach((region) => {
      const list = rawDistricts[region.value] || [];
      res[region.value] = list.map((d, i) => ({
        id: `${region.id}-${String(i + 1).padStart(3, "0")}`,
        value: d.value,
        label: d.label,
        regionId: region.id,
      }));
    });
    return res;
  }, []);

  // form state (primitive string types)
  const [username, setUsername] = useState<string>("");
  const [email, setEmail] = useState<string>("");
  const [password, setPassword] = useState<string>("");
  const [birthday, setBirthday] = useState<string>("");

  // address selection state (store ids)
  const [regionId, setRegionId] = useState<string>(""); // region.id
  const [regionValue, setRegionValue] = useState<string>(""); // region.value (key)
  const [districtId, setDistrictId] = useState<string>(""); // district.id
  const [address, setAddress] = useState<string>(""); // street / additional text

  // simple error state
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  // derived labels
  const selectedRegionLabel = regions.find((r) => r.id === regionId)?.label || "";
  const selectedDistrictLabel =
    regionValue && districtId
      ? (districts[regionValue] || []).find((d) => d.id === districtId)?.label || ""
      : "";

  function validate() {
    const e: Record<string, string> = {};
    if (!username.trim()) e.username = "Username kiritilishi shart";
    if (!email.trim()) e.email = "Email kiritilishi shart";
    else if (!/^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(email)) e.email = "Yaroqli email kiriting";
    if (!password) e.password = "Parol kiritilishi shart";
    else if (password.length < 6) e.password = "Parol kamida 6 ta belgidan bo'lishi kerak";
    if (!birthday) e.birthday = "Tug'ilgan sanani kiriting";
    if (!regionId) e.region = "Viloyatni tanlang";
    if (!districtId) e.district = "Tumanni tanlang";
    if (!address.trim()) e.address = "Manzil (ko'cha, uy) kiriting";
    setErrors(e);
    return Object.keys(e).length === 0;
  }

  function handleSubmit(e: React.FormEvent) {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!validate()) return;

    const payload = {
      username: username.trim(),
      email: email.trim(),
      birthday,
      // password would normally be hashed / sent securely
      password,
      addressFull: `${selectedRegionLabel}${selectedRegionLabel && selectedDistrictLabel ? ", " : ""}${selectedDistrictLabel}${selectedDistrictLabel ? ", " : ""}${address}`.trim(),
      region: {
        id: regionId,
        value: regionValue,
        label: selectedRegionLabel,
      },
      district: {
        id: districtId,
        label: selectedDistrictLabel,
      },
    };

    // hozircha konsolga chiqaramiz; realda API ga yuboriladi
    console.log("Form submit payload:", payload);

    // optional: tozalash
    // setUsername(""); setEmail(""); setPassword(""); setBirthday("");
    // setRegionId(""); setRegionValue(""); setDistrictId(""); setAddress("");
    // setErrors({});
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen flex items-center justify-center p-6">
      <form
        onSubmit={handleSubmit}
        className="w-full max-w-xl bg-white p-6 rounded shadow"
      >
        <h2 className="text-2xl mb-4">Ro'yxatdan o'tish — Manzil bilan</h2>

        {/* Username */}
        <label className="block mb-2">
          <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Username</span>
          <input
            className="mt-1 block w-full border rounded p-2"
            value={username}
            onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Username"
            type="text"
          />
          {errors.username && <div className="text-red-600 text-sm mt-1">{errors.username}</div>}
        </label>

        {/* Email */}
        <label className="block mb-2">
          <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Email</span>
          <input
            className="mt-1 block w-full border rounded p-2"
            value={email}
            onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="you@example.com"
            type="email"
          />
          {errors.email && <div className="text-red-600 text-sm mt-1">{errors.email}</div>}
        </label>

        {/* Password */}
        <label className="block mb-2">
          <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Password</span>
          <input
            className="mt-1 block w-full border rounded p-2"
            value={password}
            onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
            placeholder="Parolingiz"
            type="password"
          />
          {errors.password && <div className="text-red-600 text-sm mt-1">{errors.password}</div>}
        </label>

        {/* Birthday */}
        <label className="block mb-2">
          <span className="block text-sm font-medium">Birthday</span>
          <input
            className="mt-1 block w-full border rounded p-2"

"use client"

import { districts as dist, regions } from "@/types/Country.type";
import React, { useState } from "react";

export default function Home() {
  const [selectedRegion, setSelectedRegion] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [selectedAdres, setSelectedAddress] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [targetRegionID, setTargetRegionId] = useState<string | null>(null);

    username: "",
    email: "",
    password: "",
    birthday: "",
  });

  const handleChangeRegion = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    const id = e.target.selectedOptions[0].id;
    setTargetRegionId(id);
    setTargetAdresId(null);
    setSelectedRegion(e.target.value);
    setSelectedAddress(null);
    setAdres(regions.find(region => region.id === id)?.label || e.target.value);
  };

  const handleChangeAdress = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    setSelectedAddress(e.target.value);
    const id = e.target.selectedOptions[0].id;
    setAdres(

        (dist[selectedRegion!].find(d => d.id === id)?.label || e.target.value)
    );
  };

  ) => {

  };

  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent) => {

    const data = {

      address: adres,

  };

  return (

        <input
          type="text"
          name="username"

          value={form.username}
          onChange={handleFormChange}
          className="w-full border p-2 rounded"
        />

        {/* email */}
        <input
          type="email"
          name="email"
          placeholder="Email"
          value={form.email}
          onChange={handleFormChange}
          className="w-full border p-2 rounded"
        />

        {/* password */}
        <input
          type="password"
          name="password"
          placeholder="Password"
          value={form.password}
          onChange={handleFormChange}
          className="w-full border p-2 rounded"
        />

        {/* birthday */}
        <input
          type="date"
          name="birthday"
          value={form.birthday}
          onChange={handleFormChange}
          className="w-full border p-2 rounded"
        />

        {/* region select */}
        <select
          className="w-full border p-2 rounded"
          value={selectedRegion ?? ""}
          onChange={handleChangeRegion}
        >
          <option value="">Viloyatni tanlang</option>
          {regions.map(el => (
            <option key={el.id} id={el.id} value={el.value}>
              {el.label}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        {/* district select */}
        {selectedRegion && (

            value={selectedAdres ?? ""}
            onChange={handleChangeAdress}
          >
            <option value="">Tuman/Shaharni tanlang</option>
            {dist[selectedRegion].map(el => (

                {el.label}
              </option>

          </select>

          className="w-full bg-blue-600 text-white py-2 rounded hover:bg-blue-700 transition"

        prev + " " + (dist[selectedRegion].find(d => d.id === id)?.label || "")
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-screen w-full">
      <div className="container mx-auto flex justify-center items-center h-screen">
        <form className="w-[500px] h-[600px] border-2 p-4 flex flex-col gap-6">
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold">Manzilni tanlang</h1>

          {/* Region Select */}
          <Select
            className="border-2 w-full"
            value={selectedRegion}
            onChange={handleChangeRegion}
            displayEmpty
          >
            <MenuItem value="" disabled>
              Regionni tanlang
            </MenuItem>
            {regions.map(el => (
              <MenuItem key={el.id} value={el.id}>
                {el.label}
              </MenuItem>
            ))}
          </Select>

          {/* District Select */}
          {selectedRegion && (
            <Select
              className="border-2 w-full"
              value={selectedAdres}
              onChange={handleChangeAdress}
              displayEmpty
            >
              <MenuItem value="" disabled>
                Districtni tanlang
              </MenuItem>
              {dist[selectedRegion].map(el => (
                <MenuItem key={el.id} value={el.id}>
                  {el.label}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </Select>
          )}

          {/* Result */}
          {selectedAdres && (
            <h2 className="text-lg font-medium">Tanlangan joy: {adres}</h2>
          )}
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 🔑 Muhim nuqtalar:
- `MenuItem` ichida `value={id}` ishlatyapmiz → `event.target.value` bizga **id** beradi.  
- Endi `selectedRegion` va `selectedAdres` faqat `id` saqlaydi.  
- `label`ni chiqarish uchun `.find(...).label` qilamiz.  
- Har ikkala dropdown endi **MUI Select** orqali ishlaydi.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Men tushunib turibman: siz **region** tanlaganda `id`ni to‘g‘ri saqlash, keyin shu `id` bo‘yicha **district**larni chiqarishni xohlaysiz.  
Hozirgi kodingizdagi muammo shundaki, `handleChangeAdress` ichida hamon `regions.find(...)` qilayapsiz — lekin u yerda **district** kerak edi, shuning uchun `undefined` chiqyapti.

Keling, kodni soddalashtirib, to‘g‘ri mantiq bilan yozamiz:  

```tsx
"use client"

import { districts as dist, regions } from "@/types/Country.type";
import { MenuItem, Select } from "@mui/material";
import { useState } from "react";
import React from "react";

export default function Home() {
  const [selectedRegionId, setSelectedRegionId] = useState<string>("");  // faqat ID saqlaymiz
  const [selectedDistrictId, setSelectedDistrictId] = useState<string>("");
  const [adres, setAdres] = useState<string>("");

  const handleChangeRegion = (e: any) => {
    const id = e.target.value;
    setSelectedRegionId(id);
    setSelectedDistrictId(""); // reset
    const region = regions.find(r => r.id === id);
    setAdres(region ? region.label : "");
  };

  const handleChangeDistrict = (e: any) => {
    const id = e.target.value;
    setSelectedDistrictId(id);
    const district = dist[selectedRegionId].find(d => d.id === id);
    setAdres(prev => prev + " " + (district ? district.label : ""));
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-screen w-full">
      <div className="container mx-auto flex justify-center items-center h-screen">
        <form className="w-[500px] h-[600px] border-2 flex flex-col gap-6 p-4">
          <h1 className="text-lg font-bold">Manzilni tanlang</h1>

          {/* Region Select */}
          <Select
            fullWidth
            value={selectedRegionId}
            onChange={handleChangeRegion}
            displayEmpty
          >
            <MenuItem value="" disabled>Regionni tanlang</MenuItem>
            {regions.map(el => (
              <MenuItem key={el.id} value={el.id}>
                {el.label}
              </MenuItem>
            ))}
          </Select>

          {/* District Select */}
          {selectedRegionId && (
            <Select
              fullWidth
              value={selectedDistrictId}
              onChange={handleChangeDistrict}
              displayEmpty
            >
              <MenuItem value="" disabled>Districtni tanlang</MenuItem>
              {dist[selectedRegionId].map(el => (
                <MenuItem key={el.id} value={el.id}>
                  {el.label}
                </MenuItem>
              ))}
            </Select>
          )}

          {/* Result */}
          {selectedDistrictId && (
            <h2 className="font-medium">Tanlangan joy: {adres}</h2>
          )}
        </form>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

### 🔑 O‘zgarishlar:
1. Endi `selectedRegionId` va `selectedDistrictId` faqat `id`ni saqlaydi.  
2. `handleChangeRegion` → region id bilan ishlaydi, `adres`ga region nomini yozadi.  
3. `handleChangeDistrict` → district id bilan ishlaydi, `adres`ga district nomini qo‘shadi.  
4. Har ikkala dropdown **MUI Select + MenuItem** orqali.

```tsx
"use client"

import { TextField, IconButton, InputAdornment } from "@mui/material";
import { Visibility, VisibilityOff } from "@mui/icons-material";
import { useState } from "react";
import { registerInputs } from "@/types/registerInputs";

export default function RegisterForm() {
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);

  const handleTogglePassword = () => setShowPassword((prev) => !prev);

  return (
    <form className="flex flex-col gap-4 w-[400px] p-4 border-2 mx-auto">
      {registerInputs.map((input) => (
        <TextField
          key={input.id}
          name={input.name}
          label={input.label}
          placeholder={input.placeholder}
          type={input.hasToggle ? (showPassword ? "text" : "password") : input.type}
          fullWidth
          InputProps={
            input.hasToggle
              ? {
                  endAdornment: (
                    <InputAdornment position="end">
                      <IconButton onClick={handleTogglePassword} edge="end">
                        {showPassword ? <VisibilityOff /> : <Visibility />}
                      </IconButton>
                    </InputAdornment>
                  ),
                }
              : undefined
          }
        />
      ))}
    </form>
  );
}
```

### 🔑 Natija:
- `username`, `email` oddiy `TextField` bo‘ladi.  
- `password` esa `👁️/🚫` tugmachasi bilan ko‘rsatish/yashirish imkoniyatiga ega bo‘ladi.  
- Barcha inputlar massivdan map qilinadi → kod takrorlanmaydi.

## Manba: `my_digital_brain/30_Resources/learning/learning-angular/best-practices.md`

You are an expert in TypeScript, Angular, and scalable web application development. You write functional, maintainable, performant, and accessible code following Angular and TypeScript best practices.

## TypeScript Best Practices

- Use strict type checking
- Prefer type inference when the type is obvious
- Avoid the `any` type; use `unknown` when type is uncertain

## Angular Best Practices

- Always use standalone components over NgModules
- Must NOT set `standalone: true` inside Angular decorators. It's the default in Angular v20+.
- Do NOT set `changeDetection: ChangeDetectionStrategy.OnPush` explicitly. `OnPush` is the default in Angular v22+.
- Use signals for state management
- Implement lazy loading for feature routes
- Do NOT use the `@HostBinding` and `@HostListener` decorators. Put host bindings inside the `host` object of the `@Component` or `@Directive` decorator instead
- Use `NgOptimizedImage` for all static images.
  - `NgOptimizedImage` does not work for inline base64 images.

## Accessibility Requirements

- It MUST pass all AXE checks.
- It MUST follow all WCAG AA minimums, including focus management, color contrast, and ARIA attributes.

### Components

- Keep components small and focused on a single responsibility
- Use `input()` and `output()` functions instead of decorators
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Prefer inline templates for small components
- Prefer Signal Forms (`@angular/forms/signals`) for new forms. They are stable in Angular v22+ and provide signal-based state, type-safe field access, and schema-based validation
- When not using Signal Forms, prefer Reactive forms instead of Template-driven ones
- Do NOT use `ngClass`, use `class` bindings instead
- Do NOT use `ngStyle`, use `style` bindings instead
- When using external templates/styles, use paths relative to the component TS file.

## State Management

- Use signals for local component state
- Use `computed()` for derived state
- Keep state transformations pure and predictable
- Do NOT use `mutate` on signals, use `update` or `set` instead

## Templates

- Keep templates simple and avoid complex logic
- Use native control flow (`@if`, `@for`, `@switch`) instead of `*ngIf`, `*ngFor`, `*ngSwitch`
- Use the async pipe to handle observables
- Do not assume globals like (`new Date()`) are available.

## Services

- Design services around a single responsibility
- Use the `providedIn: 'root'` option for singleton services
- Prefer the `@Service` decorator over `@Injectable({providedIn: 'root'})` for new singleton services (Angular v22+)
- Use the `inject()` function instead of constructor injection


## Manba: `my_digital_brain/30_Resources/ai-chat-history/claude/apre*****siyat@gmail.com/var_function_scope_and_execution_context.md`

# Var function scope and execution context

### 🤖 Claude:

Stack - bu quti ustma-ust qo'yilgan holat 📚

Oddiy misol - kitoblar:



[Kitob 3] ← Eng yuqorida (oxirgi qo'shilgan)
[Kitob 2]
[Kitob 1] ← Eng pastda (birinchi qo'shilgan)

Qoida:

Yangi kitob tepaga qo'yiladi
Olib tashlash ham tepadan boshlanadi
LIFO = Last In, First Out (oxirgisi birinchi chiqadi)

JavaScript'da:



javascript
function birinchi() {
  console.log("1");
  ikkinchi();
  console.log("4");
}

function ikkinchi() {
  console.log("2");
  uchinchi();
  console.log("3");
}

function uchinchi() {
  console.log("Oxirgi");
}

birinchi();

Call Stack harakati:



1. [birinchi]           → "1" chiqadi
2. [birinchi, ikkinchi] → "2" chiqadi  
3. [birinchi, ikkinchi, uchinchi] → "Oxirgi"
4. [birinchi, ikkinchi] → "3" chiqadi
5. [birinchi]           → "4" chiqadi
6. []                   → Bo'sh

Xulosa:

Stack = yuqoridan qo'shish va yuqoridan olish prinsipi

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Top down ga zid emasmi

### 🤖 Claude:

Ha, zid ko'rinadi! Lekin terminologiya boshqacha ishlaydi:

Vizual tushuntirish:



Stack o'sish yo'nalishi (yuqoriga):
    ↑
[uchinchi]  ← Eng yangi (TOP)
[ikkinchi]
[birinchi]  ← Eng eski (BOTTOM)
    ↓

"Top" deganda:

Top = eng yuqorisi = eng yangi element
Bottom = eng pasti = eng eski element

Top-down deganda:

Code yuqoridan pastga o'qiladi ✅
Lekin Stack pastdan yuqoriga o'sadi ✅

Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri:



javascript
function a() {  // 1-chi o'qiladi (yuqorida)
  b();          // 2-chi chaqiriladi
}
function b() {  // 2-chi o'qiladi (pastda)
}

// Stack:
[b]    ← TOP (yangi)
[a]    ← BOTTOM (eski)

Xulosa:

Kod: top-down o'qiladi (yuqoridan pastga)
Stack: bottom-up o'sadi (pastdan yuqoriga)
Zidlik yo'q, ikki xil jarayon! ✅

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Demak kodlar stackga joylashda pastdan boshlanar ekanda

### 🤖 Claude:

Ha, to'g'ri! Kodlar Stack'ga pastdan boshlab joylashadi:

Misol:



javascript
function a() {
  b();
}
function b() {
  c();
}
function c() {
  console.log("Oxir");
}

a(); // Boshlanish

Stack o'sishi (pastdan yuqoriga):



Qadam 1:
[a] ← BOTTOM (birinchi)

Qadam 2:
[b] ← yangi
[a] ← eski

Qadam 3:
[c] ← TOP (eng yangi)
[b]
[a] ← BOTTOM

Qadam 4 (c tugadi):
[b]
[a]

Qadam 5 (b tugadi):
[a]

Qadam 6 (a tugadi):
[] ← Bo'sh

Xulosa:

✅ Birinchi chaqirilgan funksiya → pastda
✅ Oxirgi chaqirilgan funksiya → tepada (TOP)
✅ Tugash tepadan boshlanadi

Xuddi chinakam kitoblar uyumi kabi! 📚

---

// Tiplar
export type LeftTargetType = "teachers" | "groupes" | "courses" | "statistika" | "students" | "lids";

// useModalStore uchun tip va implementatsiya
interface ModalState {
isOpen: boolean;

openModal: (target: LeftTargetType) => void;
closeModal: () => void;
}

// TargetFolderStore uchun tip va implementatsiya

clearFolder: () => void;
}

export const TargetFolderStore = create((set) => ({

clearFolder: () => set({ currentFolder: null }),

// useSelectedStore uchun tip va implementatsiya

interface SelectedState {
selectedTeacherId: string | null;
selectedCourseId: string | null;
selectedGroupId: string | null;
selectedLessonId: string | null;
selectedStudentId: string | null;
selectedIds: string[];

// Selection actions
select: (id: string) => void;
deselect: (id: string) => void;
clearSelection: () => void;

// Setters
setTeacherId: (id: string | null) => void;
setCourseId: (id: string | null) => void;
setGroupId: (id: string | null) => void;
setLessonId: (id: string | null) => void;
setStudentId: (id: string | null) => void;

// Reset all
resetAll: () => void;
}

export const useSelectedStore = create((set) => ({
selectedTeacherId: null,
selectedCourseId: null,
selectedGroupId: null,
selectedLessonId: null,
selectedStudentId: null,
selectedIds: [],

// Davomat uchun tanlash
select: (id) =>
set((state) => ({
selectedIds: state.selectedIds.includes(id)
? state.selectedIds
: [...state.selectedIds, id],
})),

deselect: (id) =>
set((state) => ({
selectedIds: state.selectedIds.filter((item) => item !== id),
})),

clearSelection: () => set({ selectedIds: [] }),

// Individual setters
setTeacherId: (id) => set({ selectedTeacherId: id }),
setCourseId: (id) => set({ selectedCourseId: id }),
setGroupId: (id) => set({ selectedGroupId: id }),
setLessonId: (id) => set({ selectedLessonId: id }),
setStudentId: (id) => set({ selectedStudentId: id }),

// Reset all
resetAll: () =>
set({
selectedTeacherId: null,
selectedCourseId: null,
selectedGroupId: null,
selectedLessonId: null,
selectedStudentId: null,
selectedIds: [],
}),
}));

Masalan

```ts
export const useSelectedStore = create<SelectedState>((set) => ({
```

```ts
export const TargetFolderStore = create<TargetFolderState>((set) => ({
```

---

### 2-muammo: `fetchAll` tipi noto'g'ri

Senda

```ts
fetchAll: () => Promise
```

bu TypeScript uchun noto'g'ri.

To'g'risi

```ts
fetchAll: () => Promise<void>
```

---

### 3-muammo: `Providers` ichida destructuring

Bu ishlaydi:

```ts
const { fetchAll, error, loading, ...allData } = useAllFetchedData();
```

lekin `allData` har renderda yangi object bo'ladi.

Shuning uchun

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    console.log(allData)
}, [allData])
```

deyarli har safar ishlaydi.

Yaxshiroq:

```ts
const rooms = useAllFetchedData(state => state.rooms);
const courses = useAllFetchedData(state => state.courses);
```

yoki

```ts
const state = useAllFetchedData();

useEffect(() => {
    console.log(state.rooms);
}, [state.rooms]);
```

---

### 4-muammo: fetch tugagandan keyin log

Hozir

```ts
await fetchAll();
```

bo'lgandan keyin darhol

```ts
console.log(allData);
```

qilsang eski qiymat chiqadi.

Sababi React qayta render qiladi.

Agar fetch tugagach store qiymatini olish kerak bo'lsa:

```ts
await fetchAll();

const data = useAllFetchedData.getState();

console.log(data.rooms);
console.log(data.courses);
```

`getState()` har doim eng oxirgi qiymatni qaytaradi.

---

### 5-muammo: `useEffect`

Bunday yozish shart emas:

```ts
const getTests = async () => {
    await fetchAll();
}

useEffect(() => {
    getTests();
}, []);
```

Qisqaroq:

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    fetchAll();
}, [fetchAll]);
```

yoki

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    void fetchAll();
}, [fetchAll]);
```

---

### 6-muammo: `fetchAll` funksiyasi har renderda o'zgaradimi?

Yo'q.

Zustand store ichidagi actionlar (`fetchAll`, `setRooms` va boshqalar) stable reference bo'ladi. Shu sabab

```ts
useEffect(() => {
    fetchAll();
}, [fetchAll]);
```

to'g'ri yozilgan hisoblanadi.

---

Umuman olganda store arxitekturasi yaxshi ko'rinadi. Men faqat bitta narsani tavsiya qilardim: `ui.state.ts` ichida 3 ta mutlaqo boshqa maqsaddagi store (`SelectedStore`, `TargetFolderStore`, `AllFetchedData`) jamlangan. Katta loyiha uchun ularni alohida fayllarga ajratish (`selected.store.ts`, `folder.store.ts`, `data.store.ts`) kodni saqlash va rivojlantirishni ancha osonlashtiradi.

Sening oqiming quyidagicha:

```
App ochiladi
        ↓
Providers mount bo'ladi
        ↓
fetchAll()
        ↓
Promise.all(...)
        ↓
7 ta API bir vaqtda yuboriladi
        ↓
Store ga yoziladi
        ↓
Barcha componentlar tayyor data bilan ishlaydi
```

Bu **parallel** ishlaydi, ketma-ket emas.

Masalan:

```
Rooms      300ms
Courses    400ms
Groups     250ms
Users      500ms
Teachers   350ms
Students   450ms
Lessons    380ms
```

Jami vaqt:

```
≈ 500 ms
```

Agar ketma-ket yuborsang:

```
300+400+250+500+350+450+380

≈ 2630 ms
```

Shuning uchun `Promise.all()` juda yaxshi tanlov.

### Men seni loyihangni eslab turib aytsam

Oldingi suhbatlardan eslayman, sen **o'quv markazi boshqaruv tizimi** qilyapsan.

Bunday tizimlarda odatda:

- Rooms — kam o'zgaradi.
- Courses — kam o'zgaradi.
- Teachers — kam o'zgaradi.
- Groups — o'rtacha o'zgaradi.
- Students — eng ko'p o'zgaradi.
- Lessons — tez-tez yangilanadi.

Shu sabab men quyidagi strategiyani tanlardim:

- **Ilova ochilganda:** `rooms`, `courses`, `teachers`.
- **Sahifaga kirilganda:** `students`, `groups`, `lessons`.
- **Kerak bo'lganda:** tafsilotlar (masalan bitta student yoki bitta group ma'lumotlari).

Shunday qilsang dastlabki yuklanish tezroq bo'ladi, trafik kamayadi va ma'lumotlar ham dolzarbroq bo'lib turadi.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, bu yerda **lazy loading** yaxshi yechim bo'lishi mumkin. Lekin men uni `RootLayout` da emas, **har bir sahifa darajasida** qilardim.

Hozir sening oqiming:

```text
RootLayout
    ↓
Providers
    ↓
fetchAll()
    ↓
Rooms
Courses
Groups
Users
Students
Teachers
Lessons
```

Natijada foydalanuvchi `/courses` ga kirsa ham `students`, `lessons`, `users` ham yuklanadi.

## Men quyidagicha qilardim

### RootLayout

Faqat UI:

```tsx
<Providers>
    <Header />
    <Left />
    {children}
</Providers>
```

Hech qanday `fetchAll()` yo'q.

---

### Courses page

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
    if (courses.length === 0) {
        fetchCourses();
    }
}, []);
```

---

### Students page

```tsx
useEffect(() => {
    if (students.length === 0) {
        fetchStudents();
    }
}, []);
```

---

### Lessons page

```tsx

    if (lessons.length === 0) {
        fetchLessons();
    }
}, []);
```

Shunda faqat kerakli sahifa ma'lumotni oladi.

---

## Yana yaxshiroq usul

Hatto `useEffect` ham yozmaslik mumkin.

Masalan custom hook:

```ts
const students = useStudents();
```

Ichida:

```ts
if (!loaded) fetchStudents();
```

bo'ladi.

Component esa faqat:

```tsx
const { students, loading } = useStudents();
```

deb ishlatadi.

---

## Eng professional variant

Store'ni quyidagicha bo'lish:

```text
stores/
    room.store.ts
    student.store.ts
    teacher.store.ts
    lesson.store.ts
    course.store.ts
```

Har biri:

```ts
rooms
loading
loaded
error

fetchRooms()
```

ga ega bo'ladi.

Masalan:

```ts
const { rooms, loaded, fetchRooms } = useRoomStore();

useEffect(() => {
    if (!loaded) {
        fetchRooms();
    }
}, [loaded, fetchRooms]);
```

Bu usulning afzalligi:

- Birinchi marta API chaqiriladi.
- Ikkinchi marta sahifaga kirganda store'dagi ma'lumot ishlatiladi.
- Qayta API chaqirilmaydi (`loaded === true` bo'lgani uchun).

### Men senga yana bir narsani tavsiya qilaman

Sening loyihang admin panel ko'rinishida. Bunday loyihalarda **React Query (TanStack Query)** yoki **SWR** kabi kutubxonalar aynan server ma'lumotlarini boshqarish uchun juda qulay. Zustand esa ko'proq UI holati va global client state uchun ishlatiladi.

Masalan:

- **Zustand** → tanlangan group, modal ochiqmi, theme, sidebar holati.
- **React Query** → students, teachers, courses, lessons kabi API ma'lumotlari.

Shunda cache, lazy loading, refetch va loading holatlarini qo'lda yozishga deyarli hojat qolmaydi.

Sening hozirgi store ishlaydi, lekin loyiha kattalashgani sari React Query kabi yechimlar texnik xizmat ko'rsatishni ancha osonlashtiradi.

                    </tbody>

                Hozircha hech qanday guruh mavjud emas.

        }
        <div className={`inset-0 w-full h-screen absolute ${isOpenModal ? "flex justify-center items-center" : "hidden"}`}>
            <CreateGroup setModal={setIsOpenModal} setGroupes={setAllGroups} />
        </div>
    </div>

# Mening holatim (Angular o'rganish)

## Fon (background)
- **Frontend:** React (Zustand, Axios, Context API) — yaxshi bilaman
- **Backend:** NestJS (modular architecture), TypeScript (Union, Interface, Type) — yaxshi bilaman
- **Angular:** birinchi marta ko'ryapman, hech narsa tushunmayapman

## Maqsad
React va NestJS bilimimdan foydalanib, Angular'ni **eng yangi (signal-based, v20+/v22+)** uslubda o'rganish. Loyihadagi `best-practices.md` shu uslubni talab qiladi (standalone default, signals, `input()`/`output()`, `inject()`, `@if`/`@for`) — internetdagi ko'p misollar esa eski uslubda (`NgModule`, `*ngFor`, `ngOnInit`, `constructor injection`), shuning uchun chalkashib qolyapman.

## Hozirgacha nima qilindi
1. `best-practices.md` o'qildi
2. `README.md` tozalandi
3. `src/app/components/employee-card/` komponenti yaratildi:
   - `employee.name`/`position`/`email` maydonlari bilan `Employee` interfeys
   - `employee = input.required<Employee>()` — signal-based prop (React'dagi `props.employee`ga o'xshash, lekin funksiya kabi chaqiriladi: `employee()`)
   - Template'da `{{ employee().name }}`

## Qayerda tushunmay qoldim
- Signal nima ekani va nega `employee()` deb funksiya kabi chaqirilishi kerakligi aniq emas
- Umuman Angular komponent hayot davri (lifecycle), fayl tuzilishi (`.ts` / `.html` / `.css` ajralib turishi) React'dagi JSX'dan farqi hali join bo'lmadi

## Keyingi qadam (rejalashtirilgan)
- `employee-card`ni `app.ts` ichiga qo'shib, `employees = signal<Employee[]>([...])` bilan ro'yxat yaratish
- `@for` bilan ro'yxatni render qilish
- Shundan keyin: Services + HTTP (NestJS'dagi service'larga o'xshatib), keyin routing

## Eslatma
Endi VS Code chat orqali davom etiladi — shu fayl kontekst sifatida ishlatilsin.

# JavaScript va TypeScript farqlari

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Salom Reactda javascript va Typescript bilan ishlashdagi asosiy farqlari qisqa kodlarsiz

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Salom ✋😊 Juda yaxshi savol! React’da **JavaScript** va **TypeScript** bilan ishlashning asosiy farqlari quyidagilar:  

---

### 1. **Tiplar bilan ishlash**  
- **JavaScript** → dinamik tiplangan, ya’ni o‘zgaruvchining turini kompilyator tekshirmaydi. Kod ishlaganda xatolik chiqsa bilasan.  
- **TypeScript** → statik tiplangan. O‘zgaruvchilar, props, state, hook’lar uchun aniq tip berib qo‘yasan. Bu xatoliklarni **kod yozayotganda** aniqlashga yordam beradi.  

---

### 2. **Props va State xavfsizligi**  
- JS’da `props` yoki `state`ga istalgan qiymat tushib qolishi mumkin.  
- TS’da esa props va state tiplarini aniq yozib qo‘yasan. Bu kattaroq loyihalarda xatoliklarni kamaytiradi.  

---

### 3. **IDE yordamchiligi (autocompletion, intellisense)**  
- JavaScript’da kod yozishda yordam uncha aniq bo‘lmaydi.  
- TypeScript esa tiplari tufayli **IDE aniqroq tavsiyalar beradi**: funksiyalarning argumentlari, komponent propslari, qaytaradigan qiymatlari va h.k.  

---

### 4. **Xatoliklarni aniqlash va oldini olish**  
- JS’da xatolarni asosan **runtime** da bilasan.  
- TS esa **compile time** da ko‘rsatadi: noto‘g‘ri props yuborilganmi, noto‘g‘ri tip qaytdimi va hokazo.  

---

### 5. **Katta loyihalarga moslik**  
- JavaScript → kichik yoki prototip loyihalarda tez va oson ishlaydi.  
- TypeScript → katta loyihalarda jamoaviy ishlashda qulay: kodni tushunish, kengaytirish va xatolarni kamaytirish osonlashadi.  

---

### Xulosa  
👉 Agar kichkina “toy project” yoki tez prototip bo‘lsa — **JavaScript** kifoya.  
👉 Agar professional darajadagi, katta yoki uzoq muddatli loyiha bo‘lsa — **TypeScript** juda foydali.  

---

Xohlaysanmi, men senga **oddiy props ishlatish misolini** JS va TS bilan yonma-yon qilib ko‘rsatib beray?

---

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

TypeScript bilan yozilsa Node ishlaydimi Yoki DOM

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Zo‘r savol 😎🔥  

TypeScript o‘zi aslida **til emas, balki JavaScript’ning “superset”i**. Ya’ni, TS kodini yozganda uni bevosita **brauzer ham, Node.js ham tushunmaydi**. Avval **TypeScript → JavaScript** qilib **transpile** qilinadi (odatda `tsc` kompilyatori yoki `babel` orqali).  

Shu sabab:  

- **Node.js** → to‘g‘ridan-to‘g‘ri TypeScriptni ishlatmaydi, lekin transpile qilingan JavaScriptni bemalol bajaradi. (`ts-node` yoki `tsx` kabi paketlar yordamida esa TS kodini ham bevosita ishlatgandek qila olasan).  
- **DOM (brauzer)** → ham xuddi shunday. TypeScriptni o‘zi tushunmaydi, transpile qilingan JavaScriptni ishlatadi.  

---

### Qisqa qilib aytsam:  
- **TypeScript → transpile → JavaScript**  
- Keyin bu JavaScriptni **Node.js** ham, **brauzer (DOM)** ham o‘qiy oladi.  

---

Xohlasang men senga **Node.js da TypeScript ishlatish jarayonini** oddiy qilib ko‘rsatib bera olaman (masalan `ts-node` bilan). Buni ham tushuntirib beraymi?

### 🚦 VS Code’da Debugger ishlatish
React (Vite) yoki Node.js loyihangda ishlaydi.  

#### 1. Breakpoint qo‘yish
- VS Code’da kodni ochasan.

#### 2. Debug rejimida ishga tushirish
- Chap paneldan (sidebar) **Run & Debug** tugmasini bosasan (▶️ bilan kichik qo‘ng‘iroqcha bo‘ladi).  
- Agar React loyihang bo‘lsa → **Launch Chrome (vite)** degan config paydo bo‘ladi (agar yo‘q bo‘lsa qo‘shib beraman).

---

#### 3. Qadam-baqadam yurish
Kod to‘xtagandan keyin yuqorida tugmalar paydo bo‘ladi:  
- **▶️ Continue** → keyingi breakpointgacha yuradi.  
- **➡️ Step Over** → keyingi qatordan davom etadi.  
- **↘️ Step Into** → funksiya ichiga kirib ketadi.  
- **↩️ Step Out** → funksiyadan tashqariga chiqadi.  

---

#### 4. Variables paneli
Chapda **Variables** degan panel ochiladi.  
U yerdan:  
- `state` yoki `props` qiymatini,  
- oddiy `let`, `const` qiymatlarini,  
- hatto call stack (funksiya qayerdan chaqirilganini) ko‘rib turasan.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Haa, Fayzillo, 👀 kodini ko‘rib qoldim:  

```tsx
function Dashboard(url: string) {
  return (
    <div>Dashboard</div>
  )
}

export default Dashboard
```

Lekin bu joyda **TypeScript seni ozgina "chaqib qo‘yishi" mumkin** 😅.  

### Nima uchun?
React component **har doim props obyektini** qabul qiladi, stringni emas.  
Shuning uchun sening `url: string` deb yozganing aslida **props emas, bitta oddiy parametr**. React buni tushunmaydi.  

### To‘g‘ri usul
Agar sen `url` propsini berishni xohlasang, uni **obyekt ichida** aniqlaysan:  

```tsx
type DashboardProps = {
  url: string;
};

function Dashboard({ url }: DashboardProps) {
  return (
    <div>Dashboard — {url}</div>
  )
}

export default Dashboard;
```

📌 Endi sen `<Dashboard url="/admin" />` deb chaqirsang → ekranda chiqadi:  
```
Dashboard — /admin
```

---

👉 Xullas, `function ComponentName(props)` bo‘lishi shart. Agar bitta string bo‘lsa ham, u **props object ichida** bo‘lishi kerak.  

---

Senga bitta savol: `url` ni props sifatida ishlatmoqchiydingmi, yoki oddiy funksiya argumenti sifatida? 🤔

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Obbo end har bir propsga interface yoki type yozishim kerakm

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, Fayzillo, TypeScript dunyosida **props uchun interface yoki type yozish juda tavsiya etiladi** 😎  

Lekin, “har bir props uchun alohida type yozish kerakmi?” degan savolga qisqacha: **ha, lekin pragmatik tarzda**.  

---

### 🔹 Nima uchun yoziladi
1. **Type safety** — xato props yuborilsa, TS darrov ogohlantiradi.  
2. **Intellisense** — VS Code sening props nomlarini va tiplarini darhol ko‘rsatadi.  
3. **Documentation** — componentni ishlatadiganlar uchun avtomatik ko‘rinadi.  

---

### 🔹 Oddiy misol
```ts
type DashboardProps = {
  url: string;
  isAdmin?: boolean; // optional prop
};

function Dashboard({ url, isAdmin }: DashboardProps) {
  return (
    <div>
      Dashboard — {url} {isAdmin && "(Admin)"}
    </div>
  );
}

export default Dashboard;
```

---

### 🔹 Pragmatik yondashuv
- **Katta komponentlar** → albatta type/interface ishlat.  
- **Oddiy component** (1–2 prop) → inline type ishlatsa ham bo‘ladi:  
```ts
function Button({ label, onClick }: { label: string; onClick: () => void }) {
  return <button onClick={onClick}>{label}</button>;
}
```

- **Props juda ko‘p bo‘lsa** → alohida `interface` yozish qulayroq.  

---

Xulosa:  
**Type/interface yozish majburiy emas, lekin katta loyihada “obligatory” deb hisoblanadi**. Shu bilan kod aniq, xatosiz va IDE bilan qulay ishlaydi 😎  

---

Agar xohlasang, men senga **React’da props typing uchun tez va chiroyli patternlar**ni 3 ta misol bilan ko‘rsatib beray, shunda har bir componentda tez yozasan.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ooo, yaxshi savol 🤓  

Buning sababi — **TypeScript (yoki aslida ESLint + TS config)** senga:  
“Sen ochib qo‘ygan o‘zgaruvchi ishlatilmayapti, ehtimol bu xato” deb signal beradi.  

---

### 🔹 Nega shunday qiladi?
1. **Keraksiz kod** → loyiha kattalashsa, ishlatilmagan o‘zgaruvchilar “axlat” bo‘lib qoladi.  
2. **Xatoni oldini olish** → Ba’zida sen `const data = ...` deb yozasan, lekin keyin uni ishlatishni unutib qo‘yasan. TS seni ogohlantiradi: *“Ey, data ni ishlatmayapsan-ku!”*  
3. **Performance** → ishlatilmagan kodni olib tashlash kerak, chunki bundling paytida bo‘sh joy egallaydi (tree-shaking ham yordam beradi).  

---

### 🔹 Qayerdan chiqadi bu ogohlantirish?
- **TypeScript config** (`tsconfig.json`) → `noUnusedLocals`, `noUnusedParameters` kabi flaglar bor.  
- **ESLint** → `no-unused-vars` qoidasi ishlaydi.  

---

### 🔹 Masalan
```ts
const name = "Fayzillo"; // ❌ ishlatilmasa, warning/xato beradi
```

```ts
function greet(age: number) { // ❌ agar age ishlatilmasa, ogohlantiradi
  console.log("Hello");
}
```

---

### 🔹 Qanday qilib “tozalash” mumkin?
- Agar rostdan kerak bo‘lmasa → o‘chirish.  
- Agar keyin ishlatmoqchi bo‘lsang → vaqtincha `_` bilan boshlasang, ESLint ko‘pincha jim bo‘ladi:  

```ts
const _temp = "Fayzillo"; // warning bermaydi
```

---

Demak, bu ogohlantirish **sening dushmaning emas**, balki **yo‘ldoshing** — u seni unutuvchanlikdan qutqaradi 😅  

---

Xohlaysanmi, men senga `tsconfig.json`dagi shu **noUnusedLocals** va **noUnusedParameters** flaglarini qisqa qilib tushuntirib beray?

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

ochilgan o'zgaruvchini ishlatmaslik Error bermaydimi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Yo‘q, Fayzillo 😎 — TypeScript va ESLint **standartda bu faqat warning beradi**, xato (Error) bermaydi.  

Lekin shuni bilish kerak:  

---

### 🔹 Detallar
1. **TypeScript**
   - `tsconfig.json` ichida `noUnusedLocals: true` va `noUnusedParameters: true` bo‘lsa, **kompilyatsiya paytida Error ham bo‘lishi mumkin**.  
   - Aks holda, faqat **warning** (IDE’da sariq chiziq) ko‘rinadi.  

2. **ESLint**
   - `no-unused-vars` qoidasi odatda **warning** beradi.  
   - Agar `.eslintrc`da severity `error` qilib qo‘yilgan bo‘lsa, **lint paytida Error** beradi.  

---

### 🔹 Masalan
```ts
const name = "Fayzillo"; // ishlatilmasa

function greet(age: number) {
  console.log("Hello");
}
```
- TypeScript default: warning (IDE’da)  
- `noUnusedLocals: true`: kompilyatsiyada Error  
- ESLint default: warning  
- ESLint severity = error → Error  

---

💡 Xulosa:  
**Har doim xatolik bo‘lmaydi**, lekin katta loyihalarda `noUnusedLocals` va ESLint Error qilib qo‘yish odati bor — shunda keraksiz kodni darrov topib olib tashlaysan.  

---

Xohlaysanmi, men senga **TypeScript + ESLint bilan unused variables’ni Error qilib qo‘yish konfiguratsiyasini** tayyor qilib beray?

function Dashboard({ baseUrl, isAdmin, isMentor }: DashboardProps) {

    const [tables, setTables] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [targetUrl, setTargetUrl] = useState<string>("");
    useEffect(() => {
        const url:string = isAdmin ? `${baseUrl}/api/admin/tables` : isMentor ? `${baseUrl}/api/mentor/tables` : `${baseUrl}/api/user/tables`;

        const response = axios.get(url);
        response.then(res => {
            console.log(res.data);
            setTables(res.data.tables);
        });
        
    }, [isAdmin, isMentor]);

    function handleUrl(table: string) {
        let tableName = ""

        switch (table) {
            case "courses":
                tableName = "courses"
                break;
        
            default:
                break;
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="dashboard">
            <List className="w-1/4 h-full border-r-2 border-gray-300 p-4">
                <ListItem>
                    <h1>{isAdmin ? "Admin Panel" : isMentor ? "Mentor Dashboard" : "User Dashboard"}</h1>
                </ListItem>
                {tables.map(table => (
                    <ListItem key={table}>
                        <Button variant="outlined" onClick={() => handleUrl(table)}>{table}</Button>
                    </ListItem>
                ))}
            </List>
            <Tables url={`${baseUrl}/api/${isAdmin ? "admin" : isMentor ? "mentor" : "user"}/data`} />
        </div>
    )
}

export default Dashboard

Ya’ni sen backenddagi **table nomlari frontenddagi URL yoki logikaga har doim mos kelmasligini** oldindan bilasan. Shuning uchun `switch` yozib, har bir table uchun alohida mapping qilmoqchisiz. Bu **strategik va xavfsiz yondashuv**, chunki:  

- Backenddagi nom o‘zgarsa ham frontend xato bermaydi, faqat `switch`ni yangilaysan.  
- Dynamic URL ishlatish xavfli bo‘ladi, ayniqsa table nomi userga ko‘rsatiladigan yoki API o‘zgarmoqchi bo‘lsa.  
- Har bir case’da kerakli endpoint yoki query formatini osongina sozlash mumkin.  

💡 Maslahat:  

- Agar table nomlari va endpointlar **doimiy va 1:1 mos bo‘lsa**, dynamic qilish qulayroq.  
- Agar mos kelmasligi mumkin bo‘lsa — `switch` yoki mapping object ishlatish **best practice**.  

Masalan, `switch`ni object mapping bilan ham qisqartirish mumkin:  

```ts
const tableUrlMap: Record<string, string> = {
  courses: "courses",
  users: "get-all-users",
  exams: "all-exams",
};

function handleUrl(table: string) {
  const endpoint = tableUrlMap[table];
  if (!endpoint) return;
  setTargetUrl(`${baseUrl}/api/${isAdmin ? "admin" : isMentor ? "mentor" : "user"}/${endpoint}`);
}
```

Shu bilan `switch`ni uzun yozmasdan, mapping orqali xatolik xavfini kamaytirasan.

Sening holatingda “get-all” va “get-one” endpointlari mavjud, shuning uchun `handleUrl` ni shunday qilamiz:  

```ts
const tableUrlMap: Record<string, { getAll: string; getOne: string }> = {
  courses: { getAll: "get-all", getOne: "get-one" },
  assignedCourses: { getAll: "getall", getOne: "get-one" },
  purchasedCourses: { getAll: "get-all", getOne: "get-one" },
  lessons: { getAll: "getall", getOne: "get-one" },
  // Boshqa tables shunday qo‘shiladi
};

function handleUrl(table: string, type: "all" | "one" = "all") {
  const mapping = tableUrlMap[table];
  if (!mapping) return;

  const endpoint = type === "all" ? mapping.getAll : mapping.getOne;
  setTargetUrl(`${baseUrl}/api/${isAdmin ? "admin" : isMentor ? "mentor" : "user"}/${table}/${endpoint}`);
}
```

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ah, endi masala shundaki, token — odatda **JWT (JSON Web Token)** bo‘ladi va o‘zida **payload**da rolening ma’lumotini oladi. Backenddan alohida request qilmasdan ham uni olish mumkin. Mana tavsiyalar:  

---

### 1️⃣ JWTni decode qilish
Token odatda `header.payload.signature` ko‘rinishida bo‘ladi. Bizga payload qismi kerak (`base64url encoded`). Masalan:

```ts
export function getRoleFromToken(): string | null {
    const token = localStorage.getItem("accessToken");
    if (!token) return null;

    try {
        const payload = token.split('.')[1]; // payload qismi
        const decoded = JSON.parse(atob(payload)); // base64 decode va JSON parse
        return decoded.role || null; // payload ichida role key bo'lishi kerak
    } catch (e) {
        console.error("Tokenni decode qilishda xatolik:", e);
        return null;
    }
}
```

Shundan so‘ng:

```ts
const role = getRoleFromToken();
if (role === "admin") { /* admin panel */ }
```

---

### 2️⃣ Axios bilan default header
Siz `isAuthenticated()` funksiyasida allaqachon:

```ts
axios.defaults.headers.common['Authorization'] = token ? `Bearer ${token}` : '';
```

Buni **app boshida** yoki `axios` instance yaratganda qilishingiz yaxshiroq. Shunda har bir requestda token yuboriladi.

---

### 3️⃣ Backenddan roleni olish
Agar token ichida role yo‘q bo‘lsa, yoki siz xavfsizroq variantni xohlasangiz, backendga endpoint ochib shunday request qilasiz:

```ts
const { data } = await axios.get(`${baseUrl}/api/auth/me`);
console.log(data.role);
```

Lekin bu **qo‘shimcha request** bo‘ladi va frontend uchun unchalik samarali emas, token ichidagi ma’lumotni olish tezroq.

---

Siz frontenddan shunchaki **authenticated request** yuborasiz, backend esa tokenni tekshiradi va `JwtPayload` orqali user ma’lumotlarini beradi. Shu orqali roleni ham olishingiz mumkin.  

Masalan, frontendda:

```ts
import axios from "axios";

export async function getMyUser() {
    const token = localStorage.getItem("accessToken");
    if (!token) return null;

    try {
        const { data } = await axios.get("/api/users/get-my", {
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
            }
        });
        return data; // bu yerda user obyekti va rolening mavjud bo'lishi kerak
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("User ma'lumotini olishda xato:", error);
        return null;
    }
}
```

Shundan so‘ng:

```ts
const myUser = await getMyUser();
if (myUser?.role === "admin") {
    console.log("Admin panel ochilsin");
}
```

import './App.css'
import Dashboard from './components/Dashboard'
import { checkRole } from './utils/CheckRole';
import Header from './components/Header/Header';

function App() {

  const [isAdmin,setIsAdmin] = useState(false);
  const [isMentor,setIsMentor] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    async function checkUserRole() {
      const isAdminResult = await checkRole("ADMIN");
      const isMentorResult = await checkRole("MENTOR");
      setIsAdmin(isAdminResult === true);
      setIsMentor(isMentorResult === true);
    }
    checkUserRole();
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="w-full h-screen inset-ring-0">
      <Header isAdmin={isAdmin} isMentor={isMentor} />
      <Dashboard isAdmin={isAdmin} isMentor={isMentor} />
    </div>
  )
}

export default App

import { List, ListItem } from "@mui/material";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import axios from "axios";
import { Button } from "@mui/material";
import Tables from "./Tables";
import { tableUrlMap, baseUrl } from "../utils/Urls";
import type { DashboardProps } from "../utils/types/Props";



function Dashboard({ isAdmin, isMentor }: DashboardProps) {

    const [tables, setTables] = useState<string[]>([]);
    const [getUrl, setGetUrl] = useState<string>("");

    useEffect(() => {
        const url: string = isAdmin ? `${baseUrl}/api/admin/tables` : isMentor ? `${baseUrl}/api/mentor/tables` : `${baseUrl}/api/student/tables`;

        const response = axios.get(url);
        response.then(res => {
            console.log(res.data);
            setTables(res.data.tables);
        });

    }, [isAdmin, isMentor]);

    function handleUrl(table: string, target: "getAll" | "getOne" = "getAll") {
        const url = tableUrlMap[table]?.[target];
        if (url) {
            setGetUrl(`${baseUrl}${url}`);
        }
    }

    return (
        <div className="dashboard flex h-screen overflow-y-hidden !w-screen left-0 ">
            <div className="left overflow-y-scroll w-1/6">
                <List className="w-full h-full left-0 border-r-2 p-4">
                    <ListItem>
                        <h1>{isAdmin ? "Admin Panel" : isMentor ? "Mentor Dashboard" : "Student Dashboard"}</h1>
                    </ListItem>
                    {tables.map(table => (
                        <ListItem key={table}>
                            <Button variant="outlined" onClick={() => handleUrl(table)}>{table}</Button>
                        </ListItem>
                    ))}
                </List>
            </div>
            {
                getUrl.length > 0 && <Tables url={getUrl} />
            }
        </div>
    )
}

export default Dashboard

        const response = axios.get(url);

    function handleUrl(table: string, target: "getAll" | "getOne" = "getAll") {

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha, gapni tushundim 🚀  

Siz MUI (`@mui/material`) `Select` ishlatyapsiz, lekin ichida **`<option>` qo‘yib yuborgansiz**.  
MUI `Select` **native `<select>` emas**, u bilan ishlash uchun **`<MenuItem>`** kerak.  

👉 To‘g‘ri yozilishi quyidagicha bo‘ladi:  

```tsx
import { List, ListItem, Select, MenuItem } from "@mui/material";
```

Keyin `Select` ichida `MenuItem` ishlatamiz:  

```tsx
<Select
  className="w-full"
  displayEmpty
  defaultValue=""
  onChange={(e) => handleUrl(e.target.value)}
>
  <MenuItem value="" disabled>
    Jadvallarni tanlang
  </MenuItem>
  {tables.map((table) => (
    <MenuItem key={table} value={table}>
      {table.toUpperCase()}
    </MenuItem>
  ))}
</Select>
```

### Nima o‘zgaradi:
- **`MenuItem`** → MUI Select uchun to‘g‘ri child.
- **`displayEmpty` + disabled option** → "placeholder" rolida ishlaydi.
- Endi `Select` bosilganda jadvallar ro‘yxati chiqadi, tanlanganda esa `handleUrl` chaqiriladi.

---

Hohlaysanmi, men senga shu kodni to‘liq **`Dashboard` bilan qayta yozib**, ishlaydigan `Select` ko‘rinishini qilib beray?

Sizda `defaultValue=""` bor, lekin `" "` qiymatli `MenuItem` faqat **disabled** qilingan → shuning uchun ekranda bo‘sh chiqyapti.

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ha endi tushunarli bo‘ldi 👍 – backend senga **prisma model nomlari** (`camelCase`) formatida qaytarayapti.  
Frontendga kerak bo‘lgan URL esa **kebab-case plural** (`/api/lesson-modules/get-all`) formatida.  

Demak, qiladigan ishimiz: kelgan `camelCase` → `kebab-case` → oxiriga `-s` qo‘shish.  

---

### 🔧 Funksiya yozamiz
```ts
function camelToKebabPlural(name: string): string {
  // camelCase -> kebab-case
  const kebab = name.replace(/([a-z0-9])([A-Z])/g, "$1-$2").toLowerCase();
  // plural qilish (s oddiy qo‘shamiz, agar tugashi s bo‘lmasa)
  return kebab.endsWith("s") ? kebab : kebab + "s";
}

function buildTableUrlMap(tables: string[]) {
  return tables.reduce((acc, table) => {
    const kebabPlural = camelToKebabPlural(table);
    acc[table] = {
      getAll: `/api/${kebabPlural}/get-all`,
      getOne: `/api/${kebabPlural}/get-one`,
    };
    return acc;
  }, {} as Record<string, { getAll: string; getOne: string }>);
}
```

---

    const map = buildTableUrlMap(res.data); // res.data = array of camelCase nomlar

  });
}, []);
```

## Manba: `my_digital_brain/30_Resources/ai-chat-history/chatgpt/ummat******illlo@gmail.com/react_query_vs_redux.md`

# React Query vs Redux

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

Salom  Nextda  Teastek Query VS Redux  refresh holatlari  ma'lumotlarni yangilash qisqa

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Salom 👋  

Keling, qisqacha va aniq tarzda farqni tushuntiraman:

---

### ⚡ **React Query (yoki TanStack Query)**
- **Auto refresh**: Ma’lumot avtomatik yangilanadi — masalan:
  - Sahifa qayta fokusga olinganda (`window refocus`)
  - Internet qayta ulanayotganda
  - `refetchInterval` yoki `invalidateQueries()` orqali qo‘lda yangilaganda  
- **Cache boshqaruvi**: Serverdan olingan ma’lumotni keshda saqlaydi.  
  Shu tufayli refresh yoki sahifadan chiqib qaytganda tez yuklanadi.  
- **Qo‘llanilishi**: Serverdan olingan ma’lumotlar (remote data) uchun ideal.  
  CRUD amallaridan so‘ng `invalidateQuery` bilan real-time yangilanish beradi.  

🟢 **Afzallik**: Ma’lumotlar avtomatik sinxron, refresh bilan o‘chmaydi, kam kod yoziladi.  
🔴 **Kamchilik**: Lokal holatlar (UI state) uchun yaramaydi.

---

### 🧩 **Redux Toolkit (RTK yoki RTK Query)**
- **Redux (vanilla)**: Global state uchun, ammo ma’lumotlarni serverdan olishni o‘zi qilmaydi — `dispatch` kerak.
- **RTK Query** (agar ishlatsangiz): React Query ga o‘xshash, ammo Redux store ichida ishlaydi.  
  - Ma’lumotlar global store’da kesh bo‘ladi.  
  - `refetch` yoki `invalidateTags` orqali yangilanadi.  
- **Qo‘llanilishi**: Ham lokal, ham serverdagi ma’lumotlarni boshqarish kerak bo‘lsa.

🟢 **Afzallik**: Barcha ma’lumotlar bitta global store’da — UI, auth, socket holatlar bilan bir joyda.  
🔴 **Kamchilik**: Kod ko‘proq, React Query’ga qaraganda og‘irroq.

---

### 🧠 **Refresh holatlarida farq**
| Holat | React Query | Redux (RTK Query) |
|-------|--------------|-------------------|
| Sahifa refresh | Cache yo‘qoladi (agar persist qilinmasa) | Agar `redux-persist` ishlatilsa — saqlanadi |
| `window focus` | Avtomatik refetch | Qo‘lda refetch kerak |
| Internet reconnect | Avtomatik refetch | Qo‘lda yoki `onReconnect` orqali |
| CRUD update | `invalidateQuery()` bilan oson | `invalidateTags()` bilan ozroq murakkab |
| Global state | Yo‘q | Bor |

---

### 🧩 Xulosa
- **Agar siz faqat serverdan ma’lumot olib ko‘rsatayotgan bo‘lsangiz →** ✅ **TanStack Query**  
- **Agar loyihada global holatlar, auth, socket, va local UI statelar ko‘p bo‘lsa →** ✅ **Redux Toolkit (RTK Query)**

---

Xohlaysizmi, men sizga **qisqa misol** bilan ko‘rsatayin (masalan: `useQuery` vs `createApi`)?

### 👤 Foydalanuvchi:

React Queryda  Global State yo'qmi  yani   barcha componentada bitta  cache emasmi

### 🤖 ChatGPT:

Ajoyib savol 👏  

Ko‘pchilikni chalkashtiradigan joy — **React Query (TanStack Query)** da *aslida global holat* bor, **lekin u Redux’dagi “manual” global store emas**.  

Keling, soddalab tushuntiraman 👇  

---

### ⚡ React Query — “Global Cache” tizimi bor
- Ha, **barcha componentlar bitta global `QueryClient` instance** orqali ishlaydi.  
- Shu sababli:
  - Biror komponent `useQuery("users")` orqali ma’lumot olsa,  
  - Boshqa komponent ham `useQuery("users")` deb ishlatsa — u **xuddi o‘sha keshlangan ma’lumotni** oladi (yangi so‘rov yubormaydi).
- Ya’ni bu **global ma’lumot manbasi (cache)** hisoblanadi ✅  

---

### 🔹 Farqi shundaki:
| Narsa | React Query | Redux |
|-------|--------------|-------|
| Global holat turi | Faol *cache store* (ma’lumot serverdan keladi) | Qo‘lda boshqariladigan *state store* |
| O‘zgarishlar | `invalidateQuery`, `setQueryData` bilan | `dispatch` orqali reducer bilan |
| Maqsad | Serverdan kelgan ma’lumotlarni saqlash | UI yoki biznes logikadagi holatlarni boshqarish |
| Foydalanish | `useQuery`, `useMutation` | `useSelector`, `useDispatch` |

---

### 🧠 Xulosa:
- **React Query-da global cache bor** — lekin u **faqat server ma’lumotlari** uchun mo‘ljallangan.  
- **Redux** esa butun app’ning *holatini* (UI, modal, filter, theme, socket status va hokazo) saqlash uchun ishlatiladi.  
- Shu sababli, ko‘p hollarda **React Query + Zustand / Redux** kombinatsiyasi ishlatiladi:
  ```ts
  // server data → React Query
  // ui/theme/modal/socket → Zustand yoki Redux
  ```

    if (!target) return "Not found 404";

    const dispatch = useDispatch();
    const id = target.id;

## 🟦 1. Agar **TypeScript (.tsx)** ishlatayotgan bo‘lsang
Unda komponentni **type bilan aniq belgilab yozish** kerak:

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Modal, Typography, Box, Button, TextField } from '@mui/material';
import { useDispatch } from 'react-redux';
import { updateTodo, setLocalStorage } from '../features/todoSlice';

type Todo = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  status: 'active' | 'completed';
  createdAt: string;
};

type EditModalProps = {
  target: Todo;
  isOpen: boolean;
  setIsOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
};

export default function EditTodoModal({ target, isOpen, setIsOpen }: EditModalProps) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();
  const [todoInputs, setTodoInputs] = React.useState<Todo>(target);

  const handleChange = (field: keyof Todo, value: string) => {
    setTodoInputs(state => ({ ...state, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    dispatch(updateTodo({ id: target.id, todoInputs }));
    setIsOpen(false);
    dispatch(setLocalStorage());
  };

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setTodoInputs(target);
  }, [target]);

  const renderInputs = () => {
    return Object.entries(todoInputs)
      .filter(([field]) => field !== 'id' && field !== 'createdAt')
      .map(([field, value]) =>
        field === 'status' ? (
          <div key={field} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={value !== 'active'}
              onChange={() =>
                setTodoInputs(prev => ({
                  ...prev,
                  status: prev.status === 'active' ? 'completed' : 'active',
                }))
              }
            />
            <label>{value === 'active' ? 'Active' : 'Completed'}</label>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <TextField
            key={field}
            label={field.toUpperCase()}
            value={String(value)}
            onChange={e => handleChange(field as keyof Todo, e.target.value)}
            fullWidth
            margin="normal"
          />
        )
      );
  };

  return (
    <Modal open={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}>
      <Box sx={{ p: 4, bgcolor: 'background.paper', borderRadius: 2 }}>
        <Typography variant="h6">Edit Todo</Typography>
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">{renderInputs()}</div>
        <div className="flex w-full justify-between mt-2">
          <Button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} variant="contained">
            Close
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} variant="contained">
            Submit
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Box>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

👉 Bu holatda:
- `EditModalProps` aniq turlangan.  
- `setIsOpen` funktsiyasi `boolean` qabul qiladi.  
- `useState<Todo>` bilan holat turi aniqlangan.

import * as React from "react";
import { Modal, Typography, Box, Button, TextField } from "@mui/material";
import { useDispatch } from "react-redux";
import { updateTodo, setLocalStorage } from "../features/todoSlice";

/**
 * @typedef {Object} Todo
 * @property {string} id
 * @property {string} title
 * @property {string} description
 * @property {"active" | "completed"} status
 * @property {string} createdAt
 */

/**
 * @typedef {Object} EditModalProps
 * @property {Todo} target - Tahrir qilinayotgan todo
 * @property {boolean} isOpen - Modal ochiqlik holati
 * @property {(open: boolean) => void} setIsOpen - Modalni yopuvchi funksya
 */

/**
 * Edit Todo Modal komponenti
 * @param {EditModalProps} props
 */
export default function EditTodoModal({ target, isOpen, setIsOpen }) {
  const dispatch = useDispatch();

  const [todoInputs, setTodoInputs] = React.useState(target);

  const handleChange = (field, value) => {
    setTodoInputs((prev) => ({
      ...prev,
      [field]: value,
    }));
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    dispatch(updateTodo({ id: target.id, todoInputs }));
    setIsOpen(false);

  React.useEffect(() => {
    setTodoInputs(target);
  }, [target]);

  const renderInputs = () => {
    if (!todoInputs) return null;

    return Object.entries(todoInputs)
      .filter(([key]) => key !== "id" && key !== "createdAt")
      .map(([key, value]) =>
        key === "status" ? (
          <div key={key} className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={value === "completed"}
              onChange={() =>
                setTodoInputs((prev) => ({
                  ...prev,
                  status: prev.status === "active" ? "completed" : "active",
                }))
              }
            />
            <label>{value === "active" ? "Active" : "Completed"}</label>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <TextField
            key={key}
            label={key.toUpperCase()}
            value={value}
            onChange={(e) => handleChange(key, e.target.value)}
            fullWidth
            margin="normal"
          />
        )
      );
  };

  return (
    <Modal
      open={isOpen}
      onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
      aria-labelledby="edit-todo-title"
    >
      <Box
        sx={{
          width: 400,
          bgcolor: "background.paper",
          borderRadius: 2,
          boxShadow: 24,
          p: 4,
          mx: "auto",
          mt: "10%",
        }}
      >
        <Typography id="edit-todo-title" variant="h6">
          Edit Todo
        </Typography>

        <div className="flex flex-col gap-2.5">{renderInputs()}</div>

        <div className="flex justify-between mt-3">
          <Button onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)} variant="contained">
            Close
          </Button>
          <Button onClick={handleSubmit} variant="contained">
            Submit
          </Button>
        </div>
      </Box>
    </Modal>
  );
}
```

### 💡 Nimalar bo‘ldi bu yerda:

- `@typedef` orqali `Todo` va `EditModalProps` turlari aniqlangan.  
- `@param {EditModalProps}` → bu VSCode’ga props turlarini tushuntiradi.  
- Shunda sen `.jsx` faylda ham quyidagicha qulaylik olasan:
  - VSCode `target.` deb yozganingda — `id`, `title`, `status` kabi maydonlarni ko‘rsatadi.
